core_question: Which planet is commonly known as the 'Red Planet'? (secondary: Who was the first gymnast to score a perfect 10 at the Olympic Games?)
answer_summary: Correct answer is Mars, nicknamed the Red Planet due to iron oxide on its surface.; after the topic shift: The answer must name Nadia Comăneci, who scored a perfect 10 at the 1976 Montreal Olympics, as the first gymnast to achieve this.
